subtitle.zh: 从诊断到价值实现，六步闭环
subtitle.en: Six steps from diagnosis to value realization

summary.zh: 通过定量评估与利益相关方访谈，精准定位技术债务、组织瓶颈与 AI 就绪度差距。
summary.en: Pinpoint technical debt, organizational bottlenecks, and AI readiness gaps through quantitative assessment and stakeholder interviews.

zh: 利益相关方对齐工作坊

summary.zh: 将诊断洞察转化为可执行的路线图，明确投资优先级、能力建设路径与成功度量。
summary.en: Translate diagnostic insights into an executable roadmap with clear investment priorities, capability-building paths, and success metrics.

zh: 商业案例与 ROI 预测

summary.zh: 以最小可行产品验证关键技术假设与业务价值，在真实环境中快速迭代。
summary.en: Validate key technical assumptions and business value with minimum viable products, iterating rapidly in real environments.

summary.zh: 以平台工程和 DevSecOps 实践规模化交付生产级系统，确保质量、安全与可观测性。
summary.en: Deliver production-grade systems at scale with platform engineering and DevSecOps practices, ensuring quality, security, and observability.

zh: 运行手册与 SRE 框架

summary.zh: 通过结构化交接、知识转移与能力建设，确保客户团队能够自主运营新系统。
summary.en: Ensure client teams can independently operate new systems through structured handover, knowledge transfer, and capability building.

summary.zh: 持续跟踪业务 KPI 与技术指标，通过季度回顾与优化建议确保投资回报。
summary.en: Continuously track business KPIs and technical metrics, ensuring return on investment through quarterly reviews and optimization recommendations.

zh: 优化建议与路线图更新

desc.zh: 我们认为软件架构决策本身就是商业战略决策，而非纯技术选择。
desc.en: We believe software architecture decisions are inherently business strategy decisions, not purely technical choices.

desc.zh: 我们的成功标准是客户团队不再需要我们——每一次交付都包含能力转移。
desc.en: Our success metric is when the client team no longer needs us — every engagement includes capability transfer.

desc.zh: 从诊断到价值实现，每个阶段都由可量化指标驱动，而非主观判断。
desc.en: From diagnosis to value realization, every phase is driven by quantifiable metrics, not subjective judgment.
